Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Each had scored a victory in two matches, but on the eve of their decisive third bout, Henry suddenly announced his retirement, effectively ending both boxers' careers. Thirty years later, boxing promoter Dante Slate Jr. (Kevin Hart) makes Billy and Henry an offer they can't refuse: Return to the ring and settle the score once and for all.

programme.title: Wedding Crashers

For the irrepressible duo, there are few better ways to drink for free and bed vulnerable women. So when Secretary of the Treasury William Cleary (Christopher Walken) announces the wedding of his daughter, the pair make it their mission to crash the high-profile event. But their game hits a bump in the road when John locks eyes with bridesmaid Claire (Rachel McAdams).

programme.title: Super Troopers 2

The wacky quintet must provide law enforcement for a French Canadian town that's transitioning to U.S. sovereignty. Their unconventional methods soon get put to the test when they encounter a smarmy mayor, mischievous Mounties, a smuggling ring and a 1,300-pound bear.

programme.title: Happy Death Day

As the morning goes on, Tree gets the eerie feeling that she's experienced the events of this day before. When a masked killer suddenly takes her life in a brutal attack, she once again magically wakes up in Carter's dorm room unharmed. Now, the frightened young woman must relive the same day over and over until she figures out who murdered her.

programme.title: Scream

After he's jailed for bludgeoning the Cat Lady to death, Alex submits to behavior modification technique to earn his freedom; he's conditioned to abhor violence. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims.

Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money.

programme.title: Ocean's Eleven
programme.desc: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history.

programme.title: Ocean's Twelve

Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe.

programme.title: Ocean's Thirteen

First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties.

As the years pass, Cash ends up in Memphis, Tenn., with his wife, Vivian (Ginnifer Goodwin), and breaks into the music scene after finding his trademark sound. While on tour, Cash meets the love of his life, singer June Carter (Reese Witherspoon), but Cash's volatile lifestyle threatens to keep them apart.

When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller.

In keeping with the holiday spirit, the judge gives Davey one last chance at redemption, spend the holiday performing community service as the assistant referee for the youth basketball league or go to jail. Davey thinks he's gotten off easy until he meets Whitey Duvall, the eccentric, elf-like head referee.

programme.title: Double Whammy
programme.desc: Ray Pluto (Denis Leary) has many problems. He is satirized in the tabloids as the "loser cop." His partner (Steve Buscemi) is starting to seem suspiciously attracted to him. A pair of screenwriters (Donald Faison, Keith Nobbs) across the hall keep bugging him for help. The superintendent of his building (Luis Guzmán) is stabbed by hoodlums hired by his own rebellious daughter (Melonie Diaz). To top it off, a sexually aggressive chiropractor (Elizabeth Hurley) may just be Ray's undoing.

programme.title: The Brothers Bloom
programme.desc: Twenty-five years of swindling people are too much for Bloom, and he wants out of the business. His brother, Stephen, convinces him to work on one final hustle, targeting an eccentric East Coast heiress named Penelope. The con game fails to play out as planned when Bloom falls in love with the irresistible woman.

programme.title: The Night Before
programme.desc: For the last 10 years, lifelong buddies Ethan (Joseph Gordon-Levitt), Isaac (Seth Rogen) and Chris (Anthony Mackie) have gathered on Christmas Eve to celebrate the holidays with a bang. As Isaac prepares to become a first-time father, the friends realize that their annual tradition is coming to a sad end. To make it as memorable as possible, they plan a night of debauchery and hilarity by searching for the Nutcracka Ball, the Holy Grail of Christmas parties in New York.

Reuniting with the trainer who once made him a legend, he commits to one final showdown against the reigning title-holder: a brutal fighter determined to dismantle the ex-champ's legacy in front of the world. Pushed to his breaking point, the contender's stakes are simple: win, or lose everything he's built.

programme.title: There's Something in the Barn
programme.desc: Bill moves his American wife Carol and children Nora and Lucas to Norway where he's inherited a family estate. There, Lucas discovers a mischievous barn elf from ancient folklore living in the barn who plots to get rid of the American intruders.

programme.title: Walk of Shame
programme.desc: Meghan (Elizabeth Banks) is an aspiring news anchor in the cutthroat world of Los Angeles television. After an audition for her dream job ends in failure, she goes out for an uncharacteristic night of partying. The next morning, she awakes in a stranger's bed and hears a phone message from her agent telling her the job is hers if she can make it across town by 5:00 pm. Stranded in an unknown area without money, phone or transportation, she races to the most important interview of her life.

programme.title: Dear Secret Santa

programme.title: This Christmas
programme.desc: At holiday time, family matriarch Ma'Dere Whitfield (Loretta Devine) assembles her large brood for their first reunion in four years. However, family ties show signs of strain when various secrets come to light, especially concerning Marine Claude's (Columbus Short) true military status, Quentin's (Idris Elba) debts and teenage Baby's (Chris Brown) secret plans to become a singer.

programme.title: Leap Year
programme.desc: When yet another anniversary passes without a marriage proposal from her boyfriend, Anna (Amy Adams) decides to take action. Aware of a Celtic tradition that allows women to pop the question on Feb. 29, she plans to follow her lover to Dublin and ask him to marry her. Fate has other plans, however, and Anna winds up on the other side of the Emerald Isle with handsome, but surly, Declan -- an Irishman who may just lead Anna down the road to true love.

programme.title: Mary & George
programme.desc: Anti-Spanish riots have taken hold of the city, and with the Crown plunged into debt, George stands to lose everything; Mary faces devastating consequences when she overplays her hand.

programme.desc: George (Paul Rudd) and Linda (Jennifer Aniston) have overextended, overstressed lives in Manhattan. After George loses his job, he and Linda have little choice but to move to Atlanta and stay with his terrible brother. On the way, the couple happen upon Elysium, an idyllic counterculture community, where money, careers and clothing are strictly optional. George and Linda think that they can make a fresh start in Elysium, only they may be trading one set of problems for another.

programme.title: Priest
programme.desc: In a society ravaged by centuries of war between humans and vampires, a legendary warrior priest (Paul Bettany), a veteran of the last conflict, lives in an enclosed city ruled by the church. When a murderous pack of vampires kidnaps his niece (Lily Collins), the priest breaks his sacred vows and sets out to rescue her before the bloodsuckers put the bite on her. Joining him on his quest are his niece's boyfriend (Cam Gigandet) and a former priestess (Maggie Q) with supernatural fighting skills.

When a ruthless despot steals a billion-dollar fortune, the team is sent to steal it back on what would be for anyone else a suicide mission. What begins as an impossible heist gets worse, spiraling into an all-out war of strategy, deception and survival.

programme.desc: After petty criminal Johnny (Damon Wayans) falls for the lovely Amber (Stacey Dash), he decides to stop breaking the law and gets a gig at his crush's workplace in order to get closer to her, thus proving that he's a stand-up guy. Soon, he learns that going straight doesn't pay very well, so he decides to nab a company credit card and show off his newfound wealth to Amber. Unfortunately, a blackmailer catches Johnny and forces him to commit a crime that is far from small.

programme.title: The Block Australia

programme.title: Pike River

programme.title: FBI

programme.title: Mauri Moana

programme.title: Tagata Pasifika 2026

programme.title: Whare Taonga

programme.title: Mauri Reo Mauri Ora Kura Tuatahi

programme.title: Going Native

programme.title: Moon Tide Fishing
programme.desc: Nore and his cousin Kurtis head out on a Kanae (mullet) netting session when the seas are rough and the days are long. (R)

programme.title: Life In The FFN

programme.title: Thailand - Earth's Tropical Paradise

programme.title: Your 4x4
programme.desc: Rocky trails of The Flinders Ranges and rivers and cliffs of the Blue Mountains, Simon and the team bring you the tough adventures, scenic tracks and great off-road moments.

programme.title: Cool Cars With Dermott And Elise
programme.desc: Cool Cars with Dermott & Elise will capture the love affair that Australians have with their cars like never before. From classics to custom-built and muscle cars, Cool Cars will drive them all.

programme.title: STIHL Timbersports
programme.desc: Follow Australia's top lumberjack sports athletes as they compete with axes and saws.

programme.title: Blokesworld
programme.desc: Ado and Camera 90 head out to Rosewood for Royal George Rumble as well as the Drags at Casino Airport and they meet Brutus the legend.

programme.title: Dipper's Rigs
programme.desc: Come along each week as Dipper explores, rides, and works alongside the biggest trucks, the biggest mining & construction equipment, and the biggest farming machinery this country has to offer.

programme.title: Rides Down Under: Workshop Wars
programme.desc: We’ve assembled teams from the best of Australia’s car building & car tuning workshops. Our teams lead the way in modification, in the search to see who will be crowned the nation's best workshop.

programme.title: AFLW
programme.desc: The league, which is debuted in 2017, is the pre-eminent women's professional competition of Australian rules football in the world.

programme.title: Devil Girl From Mars
programme.desc: An uptight, leather-clad female alien, armed with a raygun and accompanied by a menacing robot, comes to Earth to collect Earth's men as breeding stock. (Hazel Court, Peter Reynolds, Adrienne Corri)

programme.title: Confession
programme.desc: A falling-out between thieves over the proceeds of a stickup results in several killings and a priest being marked for murder because of a confession he heard from one of the gang members. (Sydney Chaplin, John Bentley, Audrey Dalton)

programme.title: The Man Who Finally Died
programme.desc: After living in England since the outbreak of World War II, Joe Newman returns to the small Bavarian town of his birth to seek news of his father. (Stanley Baker, Peter Cushing, Mai Zetterling)

programme.title: Batman Forever
programme.desc: It's a brand new era for Batman, the world's favourite dark knight. Facing off with two new foes - the maniacally duplicitous Two-Face and the pathologically quizzical Riddler, he also gains a stalwart sidekick, Robin. Vying for the attentions of the nocturnal hero is hauntingly beautiful criminal psychologist Dr. Chase Meridien. Will the staggering memories of the winged crime fighter's traumatic past lead to his ruin? Or, will the unlikely alliance of two delightfully despicable villains spell the end of Batman forever. Starring Val Kilmer, Tommy Lee Jones, Jim Carrey, Nicole Kidman, Chris O'Donnell and Michael Gough.

programme.title: The Man In The Moon
programme.desc: This heart-warming coming-of-age flick set in the 50s tells the story of a 14-year-old lass who gets her first tough lesson in love.

programme.title: Hellcats
programme.desc: Marti is embarrassed when her mum comes to the qualifiers, and she tells her to leave; Savannah's sister, who's the squad captain of a rival school is injured in a fall, & Lewis accuses Alice of putting everyone's scholarships in jeopardy.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown
programme.desc: With bonus features and added scenes -- Josh teams up with Project Recover to find a missing plane and its three-man crew of Navy pilots training for World War 2.

programme.title: The Curse Of Oak Island
programme.desc: Season 3 companion talk show "The Curse of Oak Island: Drilling Down" provides a crash course for new viewers with special guests, interviews, and deep-dive discussions analysing History's hit reality series.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers
programme.desc: Mike tracks down a rare, rally-bred Italian import, a 1972 Lancia Fulvia, but to bring the coupe back to its former glory, he and Ant will need to correct bad CV joints, a broken heater, cracked dash, and a debris-clogged fuel system.

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: In a highly mechanised world, the host explores how ordinary objects are created and sheds light on the vision of geniuses and industrial designers who strive to make things better.

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: How do they collect millions of real birds' nests to make birds' nest soup? Plus, how do they use aerospace technology to make rowers go faster?

programme.title: Drive TV
programme.desc: Coming up next week on 'For the Love of the Drive'... Say goodbye to the calm allure of pies, and strap in for the roaring strength of the Defender P525 V8!

programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Meet modern-day treasure hunter Drew Pritchard. With demanding customers, high turnover, and one of the biggest salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road in search of derelict gems and for forgotten remnants.

programme.title: Miffy and Friends
programme.desc: Miffy and Aunt Alice take Baby Bun for his first day at the farm. But suddenly Bun is terrified. What could Bun see as a monster?

programme.title: Mittens & Pants
programme.desc: Mittens rides along with Fire Chief Grapefruit for the day. But the Fire Chief gets worried when Mittens begins rescuing things from high places, in a way he's never been able to do.

programme.title: Mittens & Pants
programme.desc: When Mittens and Pants agree to look after Mayor Sourdough's plant, a gift to the visiting mayor, they almost ruin it by caring too much.

programme.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programme.desc: Lachy unveils his amazing shrinking spray! But, oh no, chaos ensues when Captain shrinks Wags and himself accidentally. Lachy calls Dr. Jai and Normus for help, will they be able to find a solution?

programme.title: Mini Kids
programme.desc: Today Fantus meets cods, a gull and pollocks.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends
programme.desc: When Thomas finds a treasure map he creates "The Big Adventure Club," to seek the treasure, but when Sandy wants to join, Thomas says she's too little, so Sandy forms her own club.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Cousin Chloe, Peppa and George pick flowers making daisy-chains and transforming George into a fearsome dandy-lion.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Peppa, George, Rebecca and Richard Rabbit have so much fun playing with the marble run. Though when Daddy Pig joins in, the marble run gets much bigger.

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: The Farmer wants to turn the tree in Shaun's field into firewood. So the Flock must take desperate measures to stop their beloved tree getting the chop.

programme.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
programme.desc: When a young Watermelonsuchus gets beached during a heatwave, Ginger and the Baby Pea Rexes have to get creative to work out a way to get the giant baby into the water.

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
programme.desc: It's the Twin's birthday party and chaos ensues when their little friends arrive. The Wise Old Elf tries to entertain them, but they prove too much of a handful, turning the Wise Old Elf into a mouse.

programme.title: Flower & Flour
programme.desc: When Aunty Mia and Aunty Nina need the alley wall repainted, Flower volunteers herself and her friends for the task. Can Flower decide what to paint in time for the grand reveal, even with Flour's energetic help?

programme.title: Superkitties
programme.desc: Mr. Puppypaws steals royal objects from the museum.

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas
programme.desc: When Barbarito steals Doctora Abuela's ship and traps Santi and his crew, Tina and Abuela must save the day.

programme.title: PJ Masks
programme.desc: Kevin doesn't think he'll ever be top dog; he's not "wolfy" enough to find the legendary bone. With Gekko's help, they both learn it's through caring for others one becomes "top dog".

programme.title: The Octonauts
programme.sub-title: The Octonauts And The Immortal Jellyfish
programme.desc: While caring for sea creatures, Peso discovers an adult Immortal Jellyfish that changes into a baby when it is scared by predators. Captain Barnacles, Kwazii and Peso guard the jellyfish at a distant reef.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The squirrels are helping Duggee in the garden when Tag makes friends with a caterpillar. This caterpillar is very hungry, so Tag feeds her all the vegetable leaves they've been picking. She eats and eats and eats!

programme.title: Kangaroo Beach
programme.desc: The cadets buddy up for their first underwater orienteering adventure, ticking off sea creatures in an epic game of ocean bingo along the way.

programme.title: Fireman Sam
programme.desc: Sarah is trying to train Nipper to high-five on command. But when she isn't paying attention, Nipper wanders off and sparks an oven fire with his paw!

programme.title: Nikhil & Jay
programme.sub-title: Nikhil and Jay and the Tooth Fairy
programme.desc: When Amma has a tooth taken out at the dentist, Nikhil and Jay want to make sure she gets her first ever visit from the Tooth Fairy!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Ten presents a rundown of the top hit songs in Numberland. Learn number bonds to six, seven, eight, nine and ten with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: The Makery
programme.desc: Nim is exploring the Makery today. On her adventures she makes a bug splat picture, a hot dog mummy and a giant snail costume.

programme.title: Fizzy And Suds
programme.desc: Get ready for take-off with Fizzy and Suds. Our bubbles do a safety check with the adventurous pilot, before they take to the skies doing loop-the-loops in his plane!

programme.title: Play School
programme.desc: Emma and Kaeng meet Sara, a police officer with a bicycle! They inspect Sara's bicycle with Constable Maurice, and there's an exciting police rescue mission! Through The Windows, we see more police officers in an animation.

programme.title: PJ Masks
programme.desc: The PJ Masks defeat the Ninjas with ease and become over-confident in their powers, but Night Ninja's secretly plotting to acquire PJ powers for himself.

programme.title: Talking Tom Heroes: Suddenly Super
programme.desc: Professor Kranium hacks into Tom's super-suit to control his movements. Tom must trust his team to save him.

programme.title: Little J And Big Cuz
programme.desc: Little J moves out of home - into his very own bark shelter.

programme.title: Andy and the Band
programme.desc: While on their Mega World Tour in Australia, Andy and the Band set the kids at Rock Star School a project to unite them, but two pesky Evil Aliens plan to sabotage it.

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: It's the first day of Pup School. Dodge overcomes his first day nerves as he meets lots of new friends. The pups settle into their class activities with their new teacher Miss Collie.

programme.title: Flower & Flour
programme.desc: When Penny plans to donate the restaurant's Lost and Found to charity, Flower sets out to reunite the lost items with their owners before they're gone for good.

programme.title: Gardening Australia Junior
programme.desc: With Costa's help and the power of their imaginations, the junior gardeners choose a plant each and paint it across four seasons.

programme.title: Surfing Australia TV
programme.desc: Showcases Surfing Australia's programs from junior development through to the elite athletes in surfing.

programme.title: My Way
programme.desc: Watch go-karts and old classics fly around the track, vintage vehicles get rebuilt while powerful machines are purpose built. So if you're a rev-head, buckle up for some of the most passionate motorsport enthusiasts you'll ever meet.

programme.title: Let's Eat With George
programme.desc: George is in search of the best fusion dishes, from Asian inspired dishes to unique Peruvian-Japanese.

programme.title: Gen Well
programme.desc: Ali Daddo helps the Bracken family discover how gentle movement, a diverse diet, and stimulating the connection between the gut and brain work together for complete wellbeing.

programme.title: Find My Country House Australia
programme.desc: David and Simon explore the historical delights of Maryborough. Catriona leads them through homes with character, bringing history to life with modern comforts. Will they find the perfect blend of history and comfort?

programme.title: For the Love of Pets
programme.desc: QVS vets race to retrieve a swallowed screw from cavoodle pup Alfie. Meanwhile, RSPCA Queensland treats sweet Cavalier Gracie's heart murmur, investigates stray cat Ferrero's mysterious past, and rehomes surrendered poodles.

programme.title: Jamie Durie's Future House
programme.desc: Eden and Holly's heritage house takes a precarious journey, Gary and Lynne move home, and single mum Yindi begins her own path to housing security.

programme.title: The Garden Gurus
programme.desc: Simon checks out some exciting new robotic technology, while Trevor explains why proper nutrition is essential for a healthy, thriving lawn.

programme.desc: Live coverage of horse racing every Saturday.

S7 E13 — The Police When the police visit the school, officers Panda and Squirrel teach Peppa and her friends all about bicycle safety.
programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.desc: S5 E14 — Mummy Pig's Book Mummy Pig's book is finished, and it's time to show it off to Peppa and her playgroup friends. Unfortunately, Peppa and George lose some of the book when they are playing, and Mummy Pig has to think quickly to fix it.
programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.desc: S5 E15 — The Zoo The youngsters visit the zoo where they are shown around by zookeepers Mr Lion, Mrs Crocodile and Mr Giraffe.
programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.desc: S5 E16 — The Outback Peppa and her family are on holiday in Australia. They are visiting the Kangaroo family, who take them to explore the outback on their first day.
programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.desc: S8 E5 — Granny Sheep Moves In Peppa is playing at Suzy's house, and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in. She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio for her to make things.
programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.desc: S8 E6 — Cardboard Boxes On a rainy day, Granny Sheep plays in the garden with Peppa and Suzy. They decide to play with cardboard boxes and build a hospital, a cookie factory, and a train station.
programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.desc: S8 E7 — Clubhouse Takeaway Peppa and her friends are at the clubhouse. They are playing at serving takeaway food. The children assign themselves different roles, including a cook and a waiter. Once the imaginary food is ready, they have fun delivering it.
programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.desc: S8 E8 — Walkie Talkies Peppa and George play with walkie-talkies at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandpa Pig teaches Peppa and George how to use codenames to talk using the gadgets.
programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.desc: S8 E9 — Peppa's Office Peppa is intrigued to see her parents go to work every day. Daddy Pig makes Peppa her very own office to make her feel good.
programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.desc: S8 E10 — Little Swift Peppa finds a small bird on the ground in the garden of her house. She takes him to Dr Hamster, who explains that it is a swift and is probably tired after a long journey.
programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.desc: S3 E15 — Crab Crossing While repairing a sea wall, Sandy and Carly accidentally cut off a consortium of crabs from the shore. When the crabs start to wreak havoc among the farm animals, the duo must direct them back to the water.
programme.title: Thomas & Friends: All Engines Go

programme.desc: The Mysterious Swamp Rats / The Vanishing Mr. Blue Kit and Sam find out whether the rats in the North American wetlands are really rats. When two pied flycatchers build a nest and one goes missing, concerns about a predator arise.
programme.title: The Creature Cases

programme.desc: S3 — Paddington's Special Visitor; Paddington Celebrates Hanukkah Who is Paddington's Special Visitor that Jonathan and Judy have helped come from afar? It's the last night of Hanukkah and Mr Gruber's Hanukkiah breaks before he can light the final candle, how can another be found in time?
programme.title: The Adventures of Paddington

programme.desc: Paddington's Adventure Club Cracks The Case! / Paddington And Aunt Lucy's Special Recipe Paddington and his friends help PC Wells solve a mysterious case. Inspired by Aunt Lucy's special recipe, the Browns start a takeaway business from their home, but it proves to be hard work.
programme.title: The Adventures of Paddington

programme.desc: Paddington's Football DIlemma; Paddington Has to Say Goodbye Paddington has to decide whether to support England or Peru before the football match, but he loves both countries. It's time for Aunt Lucy to go home, but there's still time for one last adventure.
programme.title: The Adventures of Paddington

programme.desc: S8 E45 — Staying Up Late Auntie, Uncle Pig, and cousin Chloe are coming for dinner and Peppa is allowed to join too! Peppa is very proud of staying up late; she even stayed up later than the Daddies!
programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.desc: S8 E46 — The New TV Peppa and her family are watching television when it suddenly stops working. While Grampy Rabbit attempts to repair it, the family acquires a new, multifunctional TV. However, they soon realise their old set was preferable.
programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.title: How Do They Do It?

programme.desc: Over a century of Italian craftsmanship is squeezed into an accordion. Workers create callers that make duck hunters sound just like their prey.
programme.title: How Do They Do It?

programme.desc: Lost Relics. The team find lost relics of bygone times, including stools made for child-workers at an old hat dyer's factory and some classic fairground art.
programme.title: Salvage Hunters

programme.desc: Best Sellers. The team hunt for items their clients will love. In Lancashire Viki buys a set of laboratory lamps, in London Serkan nabs a 1930s papier mâché lion.
programme.title: Salvage Hunters

programme.desc: Citroen DS & Lotus 7. Paul wants to buy a Citroen DS, but Drew has major reservations. This banged up classic car is priced at £6,500- will the guys take it on?
programme.title: Salvage Hunters: Classic Cars

programme.desc: More everyday items are put under the microscope as we discover how they are made, including automotive fuel pumps, cricket bats, change machines and ductile iron pipe.
programme.title: How It's Made

programme.title: How It's Made

programme.desc: Teleshopping.
programme.title: Teleshopping

programme.desc: Teleshopping.
programme.title: Teleshopping

programme.desc: Star Wars Revival. The force is strong with paper conservator Ashleigh as she restores an original Star Wars poster. And upholsterer Ray updates a pair of 1960s designer chairs.
programme.title: Salvage Hunters: The Restorers

programme.desc: Downside. Drew visits a hip dealer in Manchester, haggles with a windmill manager in Kent and seeks artefact redemption at a Somerset abbey. Plus, he moves shop after 10 years.
programme.title: Salvage Hunters

programme.desc: Dartmouth Steam Railway. Drew is in Scotland to see a Victorian theatre in Aberdeen and the remote town of Rothes. Tee shows him how to do a deal at a steam railway in Devon.
programme.title: Salvage Hunters

programme.desc: Permit delays force the Poseidon Crew off road as they try to survive the season. Plus, the Dust Devils gamble big in the hope of finding fine gold.
programme.title: Aussie Gold Hunters

programme.desc: Marcus and Linden fear a flat battery could leave them stuck in the outback for days. Plus, Shane and Russell attempt to get their season on track.
programme.title: Aussie Gold Hunters

programme.desc: Mega Wash Plant. The Bushmen's new claim turns dangerous, forcing Rod and Les to choose between riches and safety. Plus, the Young Guns demolish their old mine.
programme.title: Outback Opal Hunters

programme.desc: Dreams. Chris Cheal's dream of two mining teams struggles to launch. Meanwhile, the Blacklighters gamble on a new claim to break a month-long opal drought.
programme.title: Outback Opal Hunters

programme.desc: Drew visits a huge antiques warehouse in Belfast. On the lookout for 18th century Irish furniture, he's excited to spot a mahogany chest of drawers.
programme.title: Salvage Hunters

programme.desc: 1950 Austin Atlantic. Henry and Fuzz head to Bristol to see Robert's 1950 Austin Atlantic. Faded and forgotten for years, can they revive this bold British classic?
programme.title: Shed And Buried: Classic Cars

programme.desc: Robin Burford. The boys visit Rob, who has an impressive collection of vintage British bikes. They find a BSA Bantam and a classic 1930's Austin Ten automobile.
programme.title: Shed And Buried

programme.desc: Paul Webb. Henry and Fuzz visit Paul in the Malvern Hills, a man with a perfectly maintained collection of Japanese motorbikes including a Honda 750 Four.
programme.title: Shed And Buried

programme.desc: Henry and Simon are in Buckinghamshire to rummage through a storage unit full of potential. They pick up a sliding cupboard and a cubbyhole shelving unit.
programme.title: Find It, Fix It, Flog It

programme.desc: Les Dennis & Sherrie Hewson. Angus unearths some family fortunes at comedy legend Les Dennis' home. Then, he checks out a selection of movie memorabilia at Sherrie Hewson's house.
programme.title: Celebrity Yorkshire Auction House

programme.desc: Huge Bids For A Rare Collection. Angus uncovers a loft stashed with bizarre but highly valuable collectables. Plus, a set of rare stamps deliver a big cash windfall at auction.
programme.title: The Yorkshire Auction House

programme.desc: Treasures Of Scotland. Can Margie Cooper make it a clean sweep as she and Mark Hill head for the heart of Edinburgh in a 1980 MGB Roadster?
programme.title: Antiques Road Trip

programme.desc: Helen Flanagan & Bobby Davro. Actress Helen Flanagan asks Angus to sell some Corrie keepsakes and haute couture, while comedian Bobby Davro brings coins and sporting memorabilia.
programme.title: Celebrity Yorkshire Auction House

programme.desc: The experts are entranced by a three-dimensional portrait of a Hindu goddess. Plus, they revive a birdwatcher's binoculars and a broken silver locket.
programme.title: The Repair Shop

programme.desc: The team revive a rusty chrome calendar ornament. They restore a 1930s schoolbook from Trinidad and a sweet little wind instrument called an ocarina.
programme.title: The Repair Shop

programme.desc: Workers manufacture toilets that massage and blow-dry. The Navy tests a pilotless helicopter. A jackhammer that doesn't cause the shakes is built.
programme.title: How Do They Do It?

programme.desc: The secrets behind keeping the cars of Daytona on the track for 24 hours of racing are revealed. The sweetest sugarcane is turned into Caribbean rum.
programme.title: How Do They Do It?

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip

programme.title: Waka Huia
programme.desc: A proud son of Ngāti Manawa, war veteran Richard Dargaville, once a soldier for the New Zealand Army, he remains forever a soldier for te ao Māori. His service reflects not just commitment to a nation, but a deep dedication to whakapapa, identity, and the ongoing struggles and strengths of his whānau and wider Māori communities. (R)

programme.title: Waka Huia
programme.desc: Through the act of karanga, we traverse both the physical and spiritual realms, guided by ancestral voices that echo through time. This sacred practice is far more than a ritual—it is a powerful form of cultural expression that binds the living with those who have passed on. Within the context of Whiria te hono, a distinguished collective of kaikaranga from Ngāti Whātua Ōrākei, the spiritual and practical responsibilities of this tradition are deeply honoured and carefully upheld. These wāhine carry the weight of generations with each call, embodying the values, stories, and mana of their iwi. (R)

programme.title: Waka Huia
programme.desc: Charlie Rahiri describes himself as a reluctant iwi leader. But he was destined by his kaumātua to lead his iwi, Ngati Ranginui. He’s a direct descendant of Iwi chief Paraone Koikoi who surrendered his guns and pouches to the colonial office in 1864, only to be back in his kainga in Taumata three years later fighting for his land by pulling up survey pegs. Miller) branch, he and his chief technical officer (Jason Bateman) must rally their co-workers and host an epic office Christmas party in an effort to impress a potential client and close a sale that will save their jobs.

programme.title: Bad Santa 2
programme.desc: Fueled by cheap whiskey, greed and hatred, Willie Soke (Billy Bob Thornton) teams up with his angry little sidekick, Marcus, to knock off a Chicago charity on Christmas Eve. Along for the ride is chubby and cheery Thurman Merman, a 250-pound ray of sunshine who brings out Willie's sliver of humanity. Mommy issues arise when the pair are joined by Willie's horror story of a mother, Sunny Soke, who raises the bar for the gang's ambitions, while somehow lowering the standards of criminal behavior.

programme.title: A Bad Moms Christmas
programme.desc: Under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla rebel against the challenges and expectations of the Super Bowl for moms: Christmas. As if creating the perfect holiday for their families isn't hard enough, they'll have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers when they come to visit.

programme.title: Furlough
programme.desc: A young woman works part-time at a prison while also caring for her mother. The rookie guard gets a chance to prove her mettle when she's tasked with accompanying a hell-raising inmate on an emergency furlough to visit her dying mother. But things soon spiral out of control, sending the pair on a surprisingly touching road trip.

programme.title: Fist Fight
programme.desc: On the last day before summer vacation, high school teacher Andy Campbell tries his best to keep it together amid senior pranks, a dysfunctional administration and budget cuts that threaten his job. Things go from bad to worse when he crosses Ron Strickland, the school's toughest and most feared teacher. When Strickland gets fired, he challenges Campbell to a fight after school. As news of the showdown spreads like wildfire, poor Andy desperately seeks any way out of his date with certain doom.

programme.title: Baby Driver
programme.desc: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Dr. Ryan Stone is a medical engineer on her first shuttle mission. Her commander is veteran astronaut Matt Kowalski, helming his last flight before retirement. Then, during a routine space walk by the pair, disaster strikes: The shuttle is destroyed, leaving Ryan and Matt stranded in deep space with no link to Earth and no hope of rescue. As fear turns to panic, they realize that the only way home may be to venture further into space.

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: When former CIA agent Jack Ryan (Harrison Ford) hampers an IRA terrorist attack in London, he kills one of the terrorists. The dead man's brother, another member of the group named Sean Miller (Sean Bean), is arrested but quickly escapes. Vowing revenge against Ryan, Miller travels to the United States, where he forces Ryan's wife (Anne Archer) and daughter (Thora Birch) into a car accident that badly injures them. This convinces Ryan to rejoin the CIA in order to track down Miller.

programme.title: V for Vendetta
programme.desc: Following the world war, London is a police state occupied by a fascist government, and a vigilante known only as V uses terrorist tactics to fight the oppressors of the world in which he now lives. When V saves a young woman named Evey from the secret police, he discovers an ally in his fight against England's oppressors.

programme.title: Apocalypse Now Redux
programme.desc: Secret ops assassin Captain Willard (Martin Sheen) is sent on a mission up a river during the Vietnam War to "terminate with extreme prejudice" the errant Colonel Kurtz (Marlon Brando). In addition to being re-edited with the new footage, the film has been completely restored, converted to digital, and reprinted by dye-transfer, improving color reproduction.

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: Ford Brody (Aaron Taylor-Johnson), a Navy bomb expert, has just reunited with his family in San Francisco when he is forced to go to Japan to help his estranged father, Joe (Bryan Cranston). Soon, both men are swept up in an escalating crisis when Godzilla, King of the Monsters, arises from the sea to combat malevolent adversaries that threaten the survival of humanity. The creatures leave colossal destruction in their wake, as they make their way toward their final battleground: San Francisco.

programme.title: Twister
programme.desc: During the approach of the most powerful storm in decades, university professor Dr. Jo Harding (Helen Hunt) and an underfunded team of students prepares the prototype for Dorothy, a ground-breaking tornado data-gathering device conceived by her estranged husband, Bill (Bill Paxton). When Harding tells Bill that Dorothy is ready for testing -- and that their privately funded rival Dr. Jonas Miller (Cary Elwes) has stolen the idea and built his own -- Bill rejoins the team for one last mission.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: Captain John Miller (Tom Hanks) takes his men behind enemy lines to find Private James Ryan, whose three brothers have been killed in combat. Surrounded by the brutal realties of war, while searching for Ryan, each man embarks upon a personal journey and discovers their own strength to triumph over an uncertain future with honor, decency and courage.

programme.title: Dexter: Resurrection
programme.desc: Dexter closes in on a ruthless killer terrorizing the city, but a fleeting clue is all he has to go on; as Harrison settles into his new role at NYPD Homicide, mounting pressure, old rivals and dangerous suspects threaten to derail the hunt.

programme.title: It Gets Worse
programme.desc: Ethan, Abi and Sam attend a funeral for an old friend from university; the funeral brings their love and loneliness to the surface; Abi reflects on her relationship with Tom; Ethan pursues Aaron; and Sam wrestles with her guilt.

programme.title: It Gets Worse
programme.desc: Ethan, Abi and Sam attempt to reconcile, but the new chapter only reveals that their messy lives are far from resolved; surely it gets better than this, right? But who needs better, when they have each other?

programme.title: 48 HRS.
programme.desc: Renegade cop Jack Cates (Nick Nolte) pulls bank robber Reggie Hammond (Eddie Murphy) from a federal prison on a 48-hour leave to help him capture Hammond's old partner, Albert Ganz (James Remar). Having escaped from a prison work crew, Ganz is on a killing spree around San Francisco, on the trail of half a million dollars that went missing after one of his robberies. The cocky Reggie knows where the money is, but spars with the hotheaded Jack as he enjoys his temporary freedom.

programme.title: The Manchurian Candidate
programme.desc: Years after his squad was ambushed during the Gulf War, Major Ben Marco (Denzel Washington) finds himself having terrible nightmares. He begins to doubt that his fellow squad-mate Sergeant Raymond Shaw (Liev Schreiber), now a vice-presidential candidate, is the hero he remembers him being. As Marco's doubts deepen, Shaw's political power grows, and, when Marco finds a mysterious implant embedded in his back, the memory of what really happened begins to return.

programme.title: Reindeer Games
programme.desc: Just released from prison, all Rudy Duncan (Ben Affleck) wants is to start a new life with Ashley (Charlize Theron), the girl of his dreams, whom he met through pen pal letters in prison. But between them and happiness stands her crazy brother, Gabriel (Gary Sinise), and his motley crew of deadly criminals who think Rudy has some inside information about a casino where he once had a job -- a casino Gabriel and his short-fused posse plan to take down.

programme.title: Pike River
programme.desc: On Nov. 19, 2010, a coal mine explosion in New Zealand kills Anna Osborne's husband and Sonya Rockhouse's son, along with 27 other men. The two women soon embark on a quest for truth and justice, leading to change they never thought possible.

programme.title: Yellowjackets
programme.desc: "Yellowjackets" tells the narrative of a team of wildly talented high-school girls soccer players who survive a plane crash deep in the Ontario wilderness. The series chronicles their descent from a complicated but thriving team to warring, cannibalistic clans, while also tracking the lives they have attempted to piece back together. Sophie Nélisse, Jasmin Savoy Brown, Sophie Thatcher and Sammi Hanratty star as the teenagers, while Melanie Lynskey, Tawny Cypress, Christina Ricci and Juliette Lewis portray their adult counterparts as they reveal the truth about their survival 25 years later.

The series chronicles their descent from a complicated but thriving team to warring, cannibalistic clans, while also tracking the lives they have attempted to piece back together. Sophie Nélisse, Jasmin Savoy Brown, Sophie Thatcher and Sammi Hanratty star as the teenagers, while Melanie Lynskey, Tawny Cypress, Christina Ricci and Juliette Lewis portray their adult counterparts as they reveal the truth about their survival 25 years later.

Using his amateur detective skills, the projectionist follows the thief to the train station -- only to find himself locked in a train car. Disheartened, he returns to his movie theater, where he falls asleep and dreams that he is the great Sherlock Holmes.

programme.title: A Little Romance
programme.desc: Intellectually precocious teenager Lauren King lives in Paris with her somewhat ditzy mother. On a movie set, she strikes up a friendship with teenage film buff Daniel Michon. After Lauren's mother forbids her to date the outspoken Daniel, the young lovebirds team up with eccentric pickpocket Julius to run away to Venice, where, according to legend, a couple who kiss under the Bridge of Sighs will stay together forever.

programme.title: Last Summer
programme.desc: Sandy (Barbara Hershey), Dan (Bruce Davison) and Peter (Richard Thomas) are three affluent, spoiled teens spending a lazy summer on Fire Island, N.Y. Both boys pepper Sandy with sexual advances, which she clearly relishes. Into their tight triangle comes chubby and naive Rhoda (Catherine Burns). Like the injured seagull Sandy both nurtures and tortures, Rhoda becomes a figure of sport, teased and humiliated by the group. Sandy's cruelty and influence bring the summer to a shocking climax.

programme.title: The Master of Ballantrae
programme.desc: Two Scottish brothers engage in fierce sibling rivalry while battling pirates, Indians and British soldiers.

programme.title: The Prisoner of Zenda
programme.desc: King Rudolf V of Ruritania (Stewart Granger) is suddenly abducted just days before his coronation is to take place. The king's evil brother, Prince Rupert (James Mason), is behind the kidnapping plot, and plans to seize the throne for himself. As the king's supporters try to find him, they stumble upon Rudolf Rassendyll (also Granger), an identical distant cousin who can pose as the betrayed ruler. The plan works well until the king's fiancée, Princess Flavia (Deborah Kerr), suspects foul play.

programme.title: The Lost City
programme.desc: An evil scientist plots to take over the world after he invents a machine that causes earthquakes.

programme.title: Dark Delusion
programme.desc: Dr. Gillespie's (Lionel Barrymore) young colleague (James Craig) treats an heiress (Lucille Bremer) for insanity against her family's wishes.

programme.title: Out-Foxed
programme.desc: Droopy is a highly civilized fox-hound.

programme.title: The Three Little Pups
programme.desc: A lazy wolf targets Droopy and friends.

programme.title: Interrupted Melody
programme.desc: Biopic of Australian star Marjorie Lawrence, who took the opera world by storm and made a remarkable comeback after being crippled by polio, with the help of her devoted husband, Dr. Tim King. Starting out by singing to crippled servicemen, like herself confined to wheelchairs, she builds a new career.

programme.title: White Heat
programme.desc: Gang leader Cody Jarrett (James Cagney) lives for his mother, planning heists between horrible headaches. During a train robbery that goes wrong, Cody shoots an investigator. Realizing Cody will never be stopped if he knows he's being pursued, authorities plant undercover agent Hank (Edmond O'Brien) in Cody's cell. When his mother dies, a distraught Cody breaks out of jail, bringing Hank along to join his gang. With Hank in communication with the police, Cody plans a payroll heist.

programme.title: San Antonio
programme.desc: Rancher Clay Hardin (Errol Flynn) has discovered that local saloon owner Roy Stuart (Paul Kelly) is selling cattle that doesn't belong to him, including some of Clay's own stolen stock. Armed with a tally book that proves it, Hardin now finds himself the target of Stuart's posse of gunslingers, who will stop at nothing to prevent Hardin from delivering the evidence to the proper authorities. With no one to help him except a few of his friends, Hardin has to fight for his cattle, and his life.

programme.title: Take the High Ground
programme.desc: Sergeant Thorne Ryan fought bravely in the Korean War, and now he does his part by taking new recruits through basic training in the southern United States. A drill sergeant has to be fierce and hated by his trainees, but is Ryan the monster he is thought to be?

programme.title: American Pop
programme.desc: This animated trek across the musical landscape of the 20th century begins with young immigrant Zalmie arriving in New York City. He's addicted to show business, but an accident ruins his voice. He marries a stripper and their son, Benny, becomes a jazz pianist. Although Benny is killed in World War II, his son, Tony, goes on to great success as a songwriter during the '60s, as does Tony's son, Pete (also Thompson), in the '80s.

programme.title: Fame
programme.desc: Young men and women audition for coveted spots at the New York High School of Performing Arts. Those who make the cut discover that it takes a lot of hard work to become a star and sometimes difficult decisions have to be made. The youngsters grapple with heavy issues such as homosexuality, abortion, attempted suicide and illiteracy. On top of their unique struggles, the students must deal with the mundane pressures of adolescence like homework, heartbreak and rejection.

programme.title: Nora Prentiss
programme.desc: A successful and hardworking doctor, Richard Talbot (Kent Smith) strays from his marriage when he meets Nora Prentiss (Ann Sheridan), a beautiful nightclub performer. While Richard doesn't want to end his affair with Nora, he also can't face divorcing his wife (Rosemary DeCamp) and struggles to resolve his inner conflict. A surprising opportunity leads Richard to develop an unlikely plan that could allow him and Nora to run off together, but the scheme may not work out the way he intended.

programme.title: Jack L. Warner: The Last Mogul
programme.desc: Rising from humble beginnings, Jack L. Warner and his brothers make movie history by founding Warner Bros. Studios.

programme.title: To Have and Have Not
programme.desc: In Vichy France, fishing boat captain Harry (Humphrey Bogart) avoids getting involved in politics, refusing to smuggle French Resistance fighters into Martinique. But when a Resistance client is shot before he can pay, Harry agrees to help hotel owner Gerard (Marcel Dalio) smuggle two fighters to the island. Harry is further swayed by Slim (Lauren Bacall), a wandering American girl, and when the police take his friend Eddie (Walter Brennan) hostage, he is forced to fight for the Resistance.

programme.title: Ladies They Talk About
programme.desc: A district attorney feels a strong attraction for an imprisoned gun moll who rises to the top of the prison ladder.

programme.title: Lady Gangster
programme.desc: Dot Burton wants to be an actress, but is stuck working as a decoy for bank robber Carey Wells and his crooks. After a big heist, Dot realizes that the boys plan to keep her share of the money. Angry at her partners and tired of crime, she hides the loot from Wells, intending to return it to the bank herself, but, before she can, she's thrown in jail for her involvement in the stickup. However, even the walls of a prison can't stop Wells from coming after Dot.

programme.title: Lady Scarface
programme.desc: A police detective (Dennis O'Keefe) and his photographer girlfriend (Frances Neal) hunt a gang led by a woman (Judith Anderson).

programme.title: Nora Prentiss
programme.desc: A successful and hardworking doctor, Richard Talbot (Kent Smith) strays from his marriage when he meets Nora Prentiss (Ann Sheridan), a beautiful nightclub performer. While Richard doesn't want to end his affair with Nora, he also can't face divorcing his wife (Rosemary DeCamp) and struggles to resolve his inner conflict. A surprising opportunity leads Richard to develop an unlikely plan that could allow him and Nora to run off together, but the scheme may not work out the way he intended.

programme.title: The Secret Garden
programme.desc: Orphaned Mary Lennox (Margaret O'Brien) arrives at the Yorkshire mansion of her mysterious Uncle Craven (Herbert Marshall). Bitter and confused after the death of her parents, she clashes with the other residents of the estate, including the surly housekeeper (Gladys Cooper), the giggling maid (Elsa Lanchester) and Craven's invalid son (Dean Stockwell). After discovering a key to a secret garden, Mary seeks the means to heal herself and the other inhabitants of the Craven household.

programme.title: The Great Sinner
programme.desc: When accomplished novelist Fedja becomes enamored of the stunningly beautiful and mysterious Pauline on a train to Paris, he abandons his plans and instead goes with her to a German casino. Fascinated by the people he meets there and wanting to remain near Pauline, he decides to study the gamblers as research for his next book. Pauline, however, is a consummate gambler herself, and her addiction slowly pulls Fedja into a world of corruption and lost luck.

programme.title: Marriage on the Rocks
programme.desc: An adman's (Frank Sinatra) wife (Deborah Kerr) winds up wed to his buddy (Dean Martin) after a quickie Mexican divorce and marriage.

programme.title: Boys' Night Out
programme.desc: After seeing their boss with his mistress, four work friends (James Garner, Tony Randall, Howard Duff, Howard Morris) decide they should get a gentleman's pad in the city. When Fred (Garner), the only bachelor in the group, rents an apartment for their dalliances, he meets gorgeous Cathy (Kim Novak), whom he hires to be their "housekeeper." Cathy lets them all make plays for her, but has no intention of sleeping with them -- she is merely doing research for her sociology thesis.

programme.title: Incendiary Blonde
programme.desc: In 1909, lively Texas Guinan (Betty Hutton) attends a Wild West show and, dressing like a man, enters a bucking bronco contest and wins. Impressed by her audacity, the show's manager, Bill (Arturo de Córdova), hires her. In order to help support her family, Texas joins the rodeo and thrills the audience with her daredevil act. Texas and Bill soon fall in love, but Bill refuses to marry her, so Texas leaves the show for the bright lights of Broadway -- not realizing that Bill hides a secret.

programme.title: The Miracle of Morgan's Creek
programme.desc: In this wacky Preston Sturges comedy, the soldier-smitten Trudy Kockenlocker (Betty Hutton) discovers that she is both married and pregnant after a raucous troop send-off party. While she has no idea who her new husband is, her longtime admirer, Norval Jones (Eddie Bracken), seizes the opportunity to help. When Trudy's cop father (William Demarest) catches wind of the situation, however, wacky misunderstandings follow, with the well-meaning Norval on the wrong side of the law.

The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and an evolutionary biologist can prevent the end of the human race.

However, the police soon break up the party and arrest them. The curvaceous quartet is unexpectedly bailed out by a drug dealer and aspiring rap artist named Alien (James Franco). Soon after, three of the four gal pals decide to join Alien in a life of crime.

programme.title: Catfish

Abby sends Nev an unusually skilled painting based on one of his photos. Intrigued, he begins online relationships with the rest of Abby's family, including her older sister, Megan. Though troubling inconsistencies soon emerge, Nev continues his online flirtation with Megan, resulting in a road trip to meet her in person.

programme.title: Shot Caller

programme.title: Hoot

After moving from Montana to Florida's Gulf Coast, he befriends Beatrice (Brie Larson) and her brother. The siblings show Roy their hideaway, where they secretly take care of a flock of wild owls. When they learn that a restaurant will be built where the owls live, the three decide to enlist the help of a local policeman (Luke Wilson) to save the birds.

programme.title: Wonka

programme.title: Game Night
programme.desc: Max and Annie's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when Max's brother Brooks arranges a murder mystery party -- complete with fake thugs and federal agents. So when Brooks gets kidnapped, it's all supposed to be part of the game. As the competitors set out to solve the case, they start to learn that neither the game nor Brooks are what they seem to be. The friends soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night.

programme.title: The Sessions
programme.desc: Though a childhood bout with polio left him dependent on an iron lung, Mark O'Brien (John Hawkes) maintains a career as a journalist and poet. A writing assignment dealing with sex and the disabled piques Mark's curiosity, and he decides to investigate the possibility of experiencing sex himself. When his overtures toward a caregiver (Annika Marks) scare her away, he books an appointment with sex surrogate Cheryl Cohen Green (Helen Hunt) to lose his virginity.

programme.title: The Nun
programme.desc: When a young nun at a cloistered abbey in Romania takes her own life, a priest with a haunted past and a novitiate on the threshold of her final vows are sent by the Vatican to investigate. Together, they uncover the order's unholy secret. Risking not only their lives but their faith and their very souls, they confront a malevolent force in the form of a demonic nun.

programme.title: The Nun II
programme.desc: An evil spreads in 1956 France as a priest is murdered, and Sister Irene once again comes face-to-face with the demonic nun Valak.

programme.title: On Becoming a Guinea Fowl
programme.desc: On an empty road in the middle of the night, Shula stumbles across the body of her uncle. As the funeral unfolds, the cousins unveil the buried secrets of their Zambian family in a vibrant reckoning with the lies we tell ourselves.

programme.title: 3 Days to Kill
programme.desc: Facing a terminal disease, spy Ethan Renner (Kevin Costner) has decided to give up his dangerous, high-stakes life in order to rebuild his relationship with his estranged wife and daughter (Hailee Steinfeld), whom he previously pushed away to keep them out of harm's way. However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence.

programme.title: Enemy
programme.desc: A mild-mannered college professor (Jake Gyllenhaal) discovers a look-alike actor and delves into the other man's private affairs.

programme.title: The Adjustment Bureau
programme.desc: Just as he is on the brink of winning a Senate seat, politician David Norris meets a ballerina named Elise Sellas. Though David is instantly smitten, mysterious men conspire to keep him away from the beautiful dancer. David learns that he is facing the powerful agents of Fate itself, and glimpsing the future laid out for him, must either accept a predetermined path that does not include Elise or else defy Fate to be with her.

programme.title: Solace
programme.desc: A psychic and a federal agent hunt a serial killer.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
programme.desc: When Austria's crown prince is found dead, evidence seems to point to suicide. However, detective Sherlock Holmes deduces that the prince was murdered and that the crime is but a piece of a puzzle designed by an evil genius named Moriarty. Holmes and his friend Dr. Watson, who are accompanied by a Gypsy whose life Holmes saved, chase Moriarty across Europe in the hope that they can thwart his plot before it can come to fruition.

programme.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
programme.desc: Baz Luhrmann helped adapt this classic Shakespearean romantic tragedy for the screen, updating the setting to a post-modern city named Verona Beach. In this version, the Capulets and the Montagues are two rival gangs. Juliet is attending a costume ball thrown by her parents. Her father Fulgencio Capulet has arranged her marriage to the boorish Paris as part of a strategic investment plan. Romeo attends the masked ball and he and Juliet fall in love.

programme.title: Dumb Money
programme.desc: Everyday people flip the script on Wall Street and get rich by turning GameStop into one of the world's hottest companies. In the middle of everything is Keith Gill, a regular guy who starts it all by sinking his life savings into the stock. When his social media posts start blowing up, so does his life and the lives of everyone following him. As a stock tip becomes a movement, everyone gets wealthy -- until the billionaires fight back and both sides find their worlds turned upside down.

programme.title: The Biggest Little Farm
programme.desc: A couple are followed through their successes and failures as they work to develop a sustainable farm on 200 acres outside of Los Angeles.

programme.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth.

programme.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Ten years after simian flu wiped out much of the world's Homo sapiens, genetically enhanced chimpanzee Caesar and his ever-growing band of followers has established a thriving colony just outside San Francisco in Muir Woods. Meanwhile, a small band of human survivors emerges, which forces Caesar -- as leader -- to grapple with the dual challenge of protecting his people and re-establishing a relationship with the remaining human population -- the latter being Caesar's secret wish.

programme.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his apes are forced into a deadly conflict with an army of humans led by a ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson). After the apes suffer unimaginable losses, Caesar wrestles with his darker instincts and begins his own mythic quest to avenge his kind. As the journey finally brings them face to face, Caesar and the colonel are pitted against each other in an epic battle that will determine the fate of both of their species and the future of the planet.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Many years after the reign of Caesar, a young ape goes on a journey that will lead him to question everything he's been taught about the past and make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike.

programme.title: The Lobster
programme.desc: In a dystopian society, single people must find a mate within 45 days or be transformed into an animal of their choice.

programme.title: The Apparition
programme.desc: Plagued by frightening occurrences in their home, Kelly (Ashley Greene) and Ben (Sebastian Stan) learn that a university's parapsychology experiment produced an entity that is now haunting them. The malevolent spirit feeds on fear and torments the couple no matter where they run. Desperate, Kelly and Ben turn to a paranormal researcher (Tom Felton), but even with his aid, it may already be too late to save themselves from the terrifying presence.

programme.title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
programme.desc: It's open season on Harley Quinn when her explosive breakup with the Joker puts a big fat target on her back. Unprotected and on the run, Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask, his right-hand man, Victor Zsasz, and every other thug in the city. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya.

programme.title: Michael
programme.desc: The journey of pop star Michael Jackson, from his early days to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fuels a pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world.

programme.title: Oblivion
programme.desc: In the year 2077, Jack Harper works as a security repairman on an Earth left empty and devastated after a war with aliens. Jack has two weeks left before his mission ends, and he joins his fellow survivors on a faraway colony. However, Jack's concept of reality comes crashing down after he rescues a beautiful stranger from a downed spacecraft. The woman's arrival triggers a chain of events that culminates in Jack's nearly single-handed battle to save mankind.

When a defector named Finn crash-lands on a desert planet, he meets Rey (Daisy Ridley), a tough scavenger whose droid contains a top-secret map. Together, the young duo joins forces with Han Solo (Harrison Ford) to make sure the Resistance receives the intelligence concerning the whereabouts of Luke Skywalker (Mark Hamill), the last of the Jedi Knights.

His brother, Stephen, convinces him to work on one final hustle, targeting an eccentric East Coast heiress named Penelope. The con game fails to play out as planned when Bloom falls in love with the irresistible woman.

But when Danny turns one of Rick's songs into the hit that reignites his career, Rick sets out to reclaim the recognition he believes he deserves, even if it means risking everything he cares about.

This turns into a lead role quarterbacking a crew of inmates in a game against a team of prison guards. Aided by incarcerated ex-NFL coach Nate Scarborough (Burt Reynolds), Crewe and his team must overcome not only the bloodthirstiness of the opposition, but also the corrupt officials trying to fix the game against them.

programme.title: Michael

programme.title: The Longest Yard
programme.desc: Disgraced pro football quarterback Paul Crewe (Adam Sandler) lands in jail, where manipulative Warden Hazen (James Cromwell) recruits him to advise the institution's team. This turns into a lead role quarterbacking a crew of inmates in a game against a team of prison guards. Aided by incarcerated ex-NFL coach Nate Scarborough (Burt Reynolds), Crewe and his team must overcome not only the bloodthirstiness of the opposition, but also the corrupt officials trying to fix the game against them.

programme.title: Oblivion

Jack has two weeks left before his mission ends, and he joins his fellow survivors on a faraway colony. However, Jack's concept of reality comes crashing down after he rescues a beautiful stranger from a downed spacecraft. The woman's arrival triggers a chain of events that culminates in Jack's nearly single-handed battle to save mankind.

When a defector named Finn crash-lands on a desert planet, he meets Rey (Daisy Ridley), a tough scavenger whose droid contains a top-secret map. Together, the young duo joins forces with Han Solo (Harrison Ford) to make sure the Resistance receives the intelligence concerning the whereabouts of Luke Skywalker (Mark Hamill), the last of the Jedi Knights.

programme.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron

As the fate of Earth hangs in the balance, the team is put to the ultimate test as they battle Ultron, a technological terror hell-bent on human extinction. Along the way, they encounter two mysterious and powerful newcomers, Pietro and Wanda Maximoff.

When Lorelei goes on a cruise accompanied only by her best friend, Dorothy Shaw (Jane Russell), Esmond Sr. hires Ernie Malone (Elliott Reid), a private detective, to follow her and report any questionable behavior that would disqualify her from the marriage.

programme.title: How to Be Very, Very Popular

Afraid of both the murderers and the cops, the two go on the run, eventually deciding to pose as male students at Bristol College. Neither girl can avoid the spotlight for too long, though, and their constant desire to stand out among the crowd eventually gets the better of them, resulting in their cover being blown.

programme.title: 9 to 5
programme.desc: Office satire about three female secretaries who decide to get revenge on their tyrannical, sexist boss by abducting him and running the business themselves. The trio, one of whom has been passed over for promotion because she is a woman, spend a night together having drug-induced fantasies of killing the slave-driving chauvinist. One of them panics the following day when she suspects she really has poisoned the tyrant.

After Katharine winds up in the hospital with an injured leg, Tess decides to exact revenge. Pretending to be her boss, Tess initiates a major deal with an investment broker (Harrison Ford) -- but things turn ugly after Katharine finds out what Tess has been up to.

programme.title: Moulin Rouge

A young poet (Ewan McGregor), who is plunged into the heady world of Moulin Rouge, begins a passionate affair with the club's most notorious and beautiful star (Nicole Kidman).

FDR and Tuck both fall hard for the beautiful blonde, turning their deadly skills and an array of high-tech gadgetry against each other in an all-out battle for her love.

In contrast, foul-mouthed, hot-tempered detective Shannon Mullins (Melissa McCarthy) goes with her gut instincts and street smarts to remove criminals from the streets of Boston. Sparks fly when these polar opposites have to work together to capture a drug lord, but in the process, they become the last thing anyone expected -- buddies.

programme.desc: Detective Riggs and Murtaugh are called into action to foil a Chinese crime lord who is selling immigrants into slavery on American soil. The pair aren't as young as they used to be, and ending up on a Triad hit list doesn't make things easy for them either.

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Episode 1 Archie Macdonald learns he's inherited a beautiful, rundown Scottish castle. However, there's a catch. programme.title: Monarch of the Glen

The pair of them are soon holed up together in Sharon's old bedsit, where they decide to take a united stand - but things are never quite that straightforward. programme.desc: S8 E16 — The One Where Joey Tells Rachel A guilt-ridden Joey finally confesses his love for Rachel to the flabbergasted Ross, while Chandler becomes nervous when Phoebe's handsome new boyfriend Don shares numerous personality traits with Monica.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S8 E17 — The One With the Tea Leaves In an effort to restore normality to their friendship, Rachel tells Joey a big lie about her unborn child. Meanwhile, Phoebe's tea leaves reveal that she will soon encounter the man of her dreams.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S8 E18 — The One in Massapequa Phoebe brings her irritatingly cheerful boyfriend to Mr and Mrs Geller's 35th anniversary party. Meanwhile, Ross is stunned when his parents ask him and the pregnant Rachel to feign marriage to avoid scandal.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S8 E19 — The One With Joey's Interview Joey is thrilled when his name is used in a 'Soap Opera Digest' crossword puzzle. He is reluctant to let the magazine do a profile of him, but Rachel tries to persuade him to reconsider so that he can mention her.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S8 E20 — The One With the Baby Shower Monica and Phoebe host Rachel's baby shower but forget to invite her mother. Rachel realises she is clueless about caring for the baby after birth. Meanwhile, Joey auditions to host a new game show called 'Bamboozled'.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S8 E21 — The One With the Cooking Class When Monica's cooking at the restaurant receives a harsh write-up in a newspaper, she goes to a criticism class taught by the reviewer, hoping to convince him to reconsider his opinion. Meanwhile, Rachel gets upset when a cute salesgirl flirts with Ross while he and Rachel are shopping for baby supplies, and nervous about a major job interview, Chandler receives some questionable coaching from Phoebe.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S8 E22 — The One Where Rachel Is Late Eight days overdue, Rachel grows irritable, prompting a bet between Monica and Phoebe. Meanwhile, Joey invites Chandler to his new film's screening.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S8 E23 — The One Where Rachel Has a Baby Rachel waits in the hospital maternity ward with an anxious Ross. To her dismay, she is put in a semi-private room. Then, the heavily pregnant Janice is assigned to share the room with her.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S8 E24 — The One Where Rachel Has a Baby Rachel doubts Ross's commitment to her and the baby. Meanwhile, Ross wants to confess his love for Rachel. Joey discovers Ross's mother's engagement ring on the floor.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S9 E1 — The One Where No One Proposes Due to a misunderstanding, Rachel finds herself engaged to Joey instead of Ross shortly after giving birth to her and Ross's baby girl. Meanwhile, Joey can't help taking a look as Rachel tries unsuccessfully to nurse her baby. Inspired to have a baby of their own, Monica and Chandler retire to a hospital cupboard for a little privacy.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S9 E2 — The One Where Emma Cries Joey's futile attempts to gain Ross's forgiveness for mistakenly asking Rachel to marry him only result in emergency hospitalisation. Meanwhile, an exhausted Rachel desperately searches for a solution to end baby Emma's non-stop crying.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S9 E3 — The One With the Pediatrician Rachel's constant calls to Emma's paediatrician force him to reject her as a patient. Meanwhile, Chandler plans to move to Tulsa for work, but worries about whether career-minded Monica is still willing to join him, and Joey and Phoebe agree to find each other companions for a double date.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S9 E4 — The One With the Sharks Phoebe fears losing her latest prospective boyfriend Mike and her self-doubt is not helped by Ross' careless comments. Meanwhile, Chandler is in Tulsa on a work assignment, and when Monica surprises him in his hotel room, she mistakenly thinks that he has a sexual fetish for sharks.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S9 E5 — The One With Phoebe's Birthday Dinner While Phoebe and Joey wait at a fancy restaurant for their friends' arrival to celebrate Phoebe's birthday, Rachel is delayed because she is afraid to leave Emma with a babysitter. Monica and Chandler also fail to arrive on time after having a row about Chandler's urge to resume smoking and then giving in to other urges.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S9 E6 — The One With the Male Nanny Ross mocks Rachel's new male nanny, and Chandler becomes upset when Monica says that somebody from her job is the funniest guy she's ever met.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S9 E7 — The One With Ross's Inappropriate Song When Chandler's former romantic rival intends to sell his flat, insecure Chandler persuades Joey to help him secretly inspect it and the guys are shocked to discover an old videotape featuring Monica having sex with Richard.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S9 E8 — The One With Rachel's Other Sister On the night before Thanksgiving, Rachel's self-centred younger sister Amy ruins everyone's holiday dinner with her uncensored observations. Meanwhile, Monica obsessively protects her good wedding china, and Joey forgets to join his television cast mates in the big Thanksgiving parade.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S9 E9 — The One With Rachel's Phone Number Rachel impulsively gives a handsome restaurant patron her telephone number, and worries that he'll call when Ross is in their apartment. Meanwhile, Phoebe's boyfriend Mike and Ross desperately try to find something in common to talk about when they babysit Emma, and Chandler returns from Tulsa to visit Monica, but must hide from Joey after rejecting his offer of free basketball tickets.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S9 E10 — The One With Christmas in Tulsa Chandler is forced to remain in Tulsa over the Christmas period due to a major deadline at work, and Monica fears the worst when she finds out that he will be joined in Tulsa by a beautiful colleague Wendy. While he works, Chandler recalls some of the more embarrassing moments from previous holidays shared with his friends.
programme.title: Friends
